Select a Rule Pack

Source: R/rule_packs.R
rule_pack.Rd

Returns a rule pack by id (which encodes the authority and version, for example "fda-2026.1"). Each indicator in the pack carries a source field for the authoritative citation that motivates it.

Usage

rule_pack(id, sources = NULL)

# S3 method for class 'rule_pack'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

id

A pack id from rule_packs(), for example "fda-2026.1".

sources

Optional named character vector mapping indicator_id to a citation, used to fill the source field. Names not in the pack are ignored with a warning.

x

A rule_pack.

...

Ignored.

Value

An object of class "rule_pack" with id, authority, version, effective_date, and an indicators tibble (indicator_id, source).

Details

The built-in packs ship with source set to NA: the citations are pending entry by someone with the regulatory references to hand, deliberately rather than filled with unverified section numbers. Supply them with the sources argument, or fill them from your own controlled reference list. This keeps the pack mechanism, the versioning, and the provenance usable now, with the citations added when they can be stated accurately.

See also

rule_packs(), rule_pack_provenance().

Examples

pack <- rule_pack("fda-2026.1")
pack
#> ℹ Rule pack "fda-2026.1": FDA, version 2026.1, effective 2026-01-01
#> ℹ   15 indicators, 0 with a source citation
rule_pack_indicators(pack)
#> # A tibble: 15 × 2
#>    indicator_id      source
#>    <chr>             <chr> 
#>  1 Q-DUP-RECORDS     NA    
#>  2 Q-FORMAT-ERR      NA    
#>  3 Q-LABEL-LEN       NA    
#>  4 Q-MISS-VAR        NA    
#>  5 Q-TYPE-MISMATCH   NA    
#>  6 R-HIGH-RPN        NA    
#>  7 R-MITIGATION-GAP  NA    
#>  8 R-OPEN-RISK       NA    
#>  9 T-AMBIGUOUS-MAP   NA    
#> 10 T-DERIVATION-DOC  NA    
#> 11 T-ORPHAN-VAR      NA    
#> 12 T-TRACE-LEVEL     NA    
#> 13 U-DEFINE-COMPLETE NA    
#> 14 U-LABEL-QUALITY   NA    
#> 15 U-REVIEWER-NOTE   NA    

# Supply citations for a controlled reference list:
pack <- rule_pack("fda-2026.1",
  sources = c("Q-MISS-VAR" = "FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide"))
